limitations: Fashion-MNIST task/review choices are scripted; not a live autonomous research study
One seed and fixed CNN, only two epochs; no architecture or multi-seed comparison
Epoch-boundary equivalence only; arbitrary optimizer/scheduler/mid-batch restore remains experiment code responsibility
Not GPU saturation/throughput telemetry or VRAM hard quota; unrelated GPU apps are not excluded
Run-local blob storage; no garbage collection, cross-run deduplication or automatic large-file backup
Output monitoring is periodic rather than hard disk quota
START_UNCERTAIN/LOST requires owner intervention; no blind relaunch
Local trace viewer with best-effort redaction, not hosted LangSmith or hidden reasoning collection
New model architectures require reviewed registered evaluator adapters; generic CLI does not auto-load them
Linux/WSL execution only, not native Windows
ci: GitHub check status on PR head is authoritative; GPU evidence is local manual verification
